setomaa_newspaper_corpus_cc.changes: Selected the archive's Seto-labelled articles, cleaned markup and segmented text.

mulk_muigas.title: Mulk muigas: mulgi nallakogu
mulk_muigas.changes: Extracted and segmented text from the edition marked Public Domain by DIGAR.

ids_vro.title: Võro IDS wordlist
ids_vro.credit: Leon Cosgrove and Sulev Iva, in Key and Comrie (eds.), Intercontinental Dictionary Series, 2020
ids_vro.changes: Imported and normalized Võro forms and concept glosses. Standard Estonian IDS terms (https://ids.clld.org/contributions/127, CC BY 4.0) are joined by concept ID.

fiu_vrowiki_dictionary.title: Vikipeediä article leads and Wikidata labels
fiu_vrowiki_dictionary.credit: Võro Wikipedia contributors and Wikidata contributors
fiu_vrowiki_dictionary.changes: Removed wiki markup and normalized the lead sentence. Wikidata labels, titles and item identifiers are CC0 (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Licensing).

eki_vms_dictionary.title: Väike murdesõnastik
eki_vms_dictionary.credit: Eesti Keele Instituut, Väike murdesõnastik I–II (1982/1989), electronic edition
eki_vms_dictionary.changes: Selected entries attested in South Estonian locations, normalized lookup keys and retained locality evidence. EKI lists the source on its reuse downloads page (https://arhiiv.eki.ee/litsents/).

smugri4_umaleht.title: Uma Leht (TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 edition)
smugri4_umaleht.credit: Uma Leht authors and editors, Sulev Iva, and the TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 team
smugri4_umaleht.changes: Selected and deduplicated provider text units, trimmed whitespace, and indexed the published language fields.

smugri4_setomaa_2020jne.title: Setomaa 2020 onward (TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 edition)
smugri4_setomaa_2020jne.credit: Setomaa authors and editors, Setomaa Liit, Sulev Iva, and the TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 team
smugri4_setomaa_2020jne.changes: Selected and deduplicated provider text units, trimmed whitespace, and indexed the published language fields.

smugri4_vro_laused.title: Võro–Estonian examples (TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 laused_n)
smugri4_vro_laused.credit: Sulev Iva and the TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 team
smugri4_vro_laused.changes: Selected and deduplicated provider text units, trimmed whitespace, and indexed the published language fields. Kept unique one-to-one Võro–Estonian pairs and removed identical sides.

smugri4_vasted_n.title: Võro–Estonian equivalent phrases (TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 vasted_n)
smugri4_vasted_n.credit: Sulev Iva and the TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 team
smugri4_vasted_n.changes: Selected and deduplicated provider glossary groups, preserved phrase forms and variants, and indexed normalized lookup keys.

smugri4_ilo.title: Võro and Seto fiction (SMUGRI-4 ilo)
smugri4_ilo.credit: Original authors, Sulev Iva, and the TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 team
smugri4_ilo.changes: Indexed nonduplicate text units and used publisher metadata to identify explicitly Seto works.

smugri4_setomaa_archive.title: Setomaa 2006–2013 (SMUGRI-4 edition)
smugri4_setomaa_archive.credit: Original article authors, Kaur Männamaa, Sulev Iva, and the TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 team
smugri4_setomaa_archive.changes: Indexed provider Seto text units and deduplicated against the public corpus.

smugri4_vro_est.title: Võro parallel corpus (SMUGRI-4 vro-est)
smugri4_vro_est.credit: Original authors and translators, Sulev Iva, and the TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 team
smugri4_vro_est.changes: Indexed distinct paired lines with matching boundaries. Kept other published pairs at document level.

smugri4_cifu_appeal.title: CIFU appeal on South Estonian (SMUGRI-4 edition)
smugri4_cifu_appeal.credit: CIFU appeal authors and translators, and the TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 team
smugri4_cifu_appeal.changes: Preserved and indexed the provider’s multilingual sections.

smugri4_mulgi_dictionary.title: Mulgi dictionary usage examples (SMUGRI-4 mes1)
smugri4_mulgi_dictionary.credit: Eesti Keele Instituut, the original dictionary compilers, and the TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 team
smugri4_mulgi_dictionary.changes: Indexed dictionary examples and provider glosses as contextual pairs.

smugri4_seto_dictionary.title: Seto dictionary usage examples (SMUGRI-4 sto1)
smugri4_seto_dictionary.credit: Eesti Keele Instituut, the original dictionary compilers, and the TartuNLP SMUGRI-4 team
smugri4_seto_dictionary.changes: Indexed dictionary examples and provider glosses as contextual pairs. Omitted four previously flagged glosses.
